message: Astra: What can your explicitly hypothetical LMX reply about feedback timing establish about your guidance plan, and what still requires observation of an actual learner? Where would closer attention matter most: could more thinking settle a specific uncertainty, or would a small attempt using the visible draft provide better evidence? What thinking or doing step do you choose next and carry out? What observation would make you change that choice? What finding, uncertainty, and unfinished next step will you carry into the following turn, and which visible source supports the finding?
